name: HYDRA-UMC-ANDROID-CONTROL
notes: Native Android control app with biometric login, talking to HYDRA-UMC-SERVER over Wi-Fi/Bluetooth. It receives paired Wear OS Data Layer voice/status messages, keeps the Server JWT encrypted on the phone and returns bounded replies; that path never issues robot commands. Declares a real Wear OS android_wear_capabilities resource (hydra_umc_phone_companion) so the paired Watch can discover this exact app via CapabilityClient instead of trusting connectedNodes ordering. A red STOP button in the top bar of every screen, on the control console and on the 3D view, the home-screen widget and the notification action all send one POST /api/stop-all (no hold, no confirmation) that stops every robot, with a retry, a per-robot fallback on 429 and a persistent STOP NOT CONFIRMED state.
